skill.summary: Apply the five-stage design thinking process — Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test — to everyday personal and professional challenges.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Design Thinking for Life.

- Introduces the five-stage design thinking process (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test) for personal and professional problem-solving.
- Adapts professional design thinking methods for individuals and small teams facing real-life challenges.
- Provides structured prompts, techniques, and criteria for each stage, including empathy maps, POV statements, ideation tools, prototyping formats, and testing plans.
- Includes guidance on iterating between stages and clear safety/compliance reminders.
- Offers detailed examples to illustrate a complete walkthrough of the process.
